 CRAWFORD PARTNERS, LP'S MOTION TO CORRECT APPLICANTS' NOTICE OF
     COMPLIANCE WITH PREHEARING SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS


       TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

       Crawford Partners, LP ("Crawford Partners” or "Movant"), an intervenor in the above-

captioned proceeding, files this Motion to Correct Applicants' Notice of Compliance with

Prehearing Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 and, in support thereof,

respectfully shows the following:

                               I.      MOTION TO CORRECT

       On June 3, 2026, Applicants, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA

Transmission Services Corporation (collectively, "Applicants"), filed their Notice of Compliance

with Prehearing Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23, including Attachment

2, which Applicants represent serves as the basis for the proposed order of presentation and cross-

examination at the hearing on the merits.


                                            Page 1 of 3
         Upon review of Attachment 2, Crawford Partners determined that it was inadvertently

omitted from the list of intervenors, though its partner Thomas Crawford is listed as an intervening

party, but it incorrectly associates Thomas Crawford with Segment Link P1. The correct route

segment associated with Movants' intervention and opposition is Segment Link U1.

        Accordingly, Attachment 2 to Applicants’ June 3rd filing contains a clerical or

administrative error by identifying Crawford Partners by only its Partner, Thomas Crawford, and

associating Thomas Crawford with Segment Link P1 rather than Segment Link U1.

        Because the evidentiary record clearly demonstrates that Thomas Crawford is Partner for

Crawford Partners, LP, Crawford Partners being the intervening party oppose Segment Link U1,

good cause exists for the Presiding Administrative Law Judges to direct Applicants to amend

Attachment 2 to reflect the correct route segment designation and name of intervenor, Crawford

Partners LP. Correcting this administrative error will ensure that the proposed order of presentation

and cross-examination accurately reflects the issues and routing alternatives at stake and will

facilitate the efficient conduct of the hearing.

                                          II.       PRAYER

        WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, Crawford Partners LP respectfully requests

that the Presiding Administrative Law Judges:

    1. Grant this Motion;

    2. Order Applicants to correct Attachment 2 to their Notice of Compliance with Prehearing

        Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 to reflect that Thomas Crawford

        is Partner for Crawford Partners, LP, the intervening party.

    3. Crawford Partners is oppose Segment Link U1, rather than Segment Link P1;




                                                Page 2 of 3
    4. Direct that the corrected Attachment 2 be utilized as the basis for the order of presentation

       and cross-examination at the hearing on the merits; and

   5. Grant Crawford Partners such other and further relief to which it may be justly entitled.




       Respectfully submitted,

       Date: June 5, 2026


                                                    Respectfully submitted       on    behalf     of
                                                    Crawford Partners LP
